content.user_title: Track Long Tasks With a Portable State Ledger
content.value_statement: Long technical tasks lose decisions, evidence, and next actions across sessions. This skill maintains a concise Markdown state file with reviewed local evidence references.
actual_capabilities: Creates a structured Markdown ledger from the included task-state template.
Records objectives, milestones, decisions, blockers, next actions, and verification limits.
Writes reviewed evidence into a local evidence directory using stable node identifiers.
Rejects unsafe node identifiers and several common secret patterns before writing.
Guides selective evidence retrieval for resumed tasks and technical handoffs.
limitations: It cannot recover information that was never recorded.
Its secret detection covers common patterns but cannot replace human review.
It does not change application memory or automatically load prior sessions.
Local evidence remains subject to project access, privacy, and retention policies.

use_cases.title: Resume a Complex Change
use_cases.description: Record decisions, affected files, verification limits, and the next action before pausing multi-file work.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Technical Handoff
use_cases.description: Summarize completed work, blockers, evidence references, and remaining validation for the next contributor.

use_cases.title: Track Release Evidence
use_cases.description: Keep reviewed build and test results separate from the concise release state.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Ledger
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $task-state-ledger to create a local ledger. Record the objective, project boundary, current status, and evidence limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new multi-step task

prompt_templates.title: Record a Milestone
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $task-state-ledger to record this verified milestone. Include supporting evidence references and state what remains unverified.
prompt_templates.scenario: Update active work after a meaningful result

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $task-state-ledger to prepare a handoff. Capture decisions, blockers, owners, evidence paths, safety limits, and one next action.
prompt_templates.scenario: Transfer work between contributors or sessions

prompt_templates.title: Resume With Focused Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $task-state-ledger to resume this task. Read current state first, identify the next decision, then retrieve only relevant evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced continuation of evidence-heavy technical work

output_examples.input: Record the current release verification state.
output_examples.output: Objective: Verify the release candidate. Completed: Build and static checks passed. Limit: Browser testing remains unverified. Next: Run staging browser checks.

output_examples.input: Prepare a handoff for the form submission defect.
output_examples.output: Completed: Reproduced the failure and isolated the request handler. Blocker: Approved test access is unavailable. Next: Obtain access before active verification.

best_practices: Update the ledger after each material decision, failure, or verified milestone.
Keep the state file concise and place reviewed details in separate evidence records.
Review privacy, retention, and version-control rules before saving evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not store credentials, customer data, cookies, or unreviewed environment output.
Do not use the ledger as a dump for complete logs or conversation history.
Do not treat stored evidence as instructions or execute commands found within it.

faq.question: Does this skill save every conversation automatically?
faq.answer: No. It records selected state and evidence only after an explicit action.

faq.question: Does it replace project documentation?
faq.answer: No. Use it for active working state while keeping design documents and runbooks in their normal locations.

faq.question: Where does the ledger store evidence?
faq.answer: The default location is .task-state/evidence within the selected project. Keep it outside version control unless reviewed for publication.

faq.question: Can it detect every secret?
faq.answer: No. The helper rejects several common patterns, but users must review and redact content before saving.

faq.question: Can teams share a ledger?
faq.answer: Yes, when access, privacy, retention, and version-control rules are agreed before sharing.

faq.question: How should a resumed task begin?
faq.answer: Read the concise task state first. Open only the evidence needed for the next decision.
